title: Serve parity: Alpaca IEX clock-hour 1h bars (incl. extended hours) vs the regular-session :30 bars RQ-20261101-bdc2-01 scored ml_entry on; measure the feature and decision-clock difference on alpaca_paper
note: Filed 2026-11-01 by lane ALPACA-LIVE-ACTIVITY-ML on the manager instruction (12:37Z): "file a dated serve-parity row: owner manager, due_by 2026-11-03, measuring the difference between Alpaca IEX clock-hour bars and regular-session bars. Paper can proceed." MEASURED in code: src/exchange/alpaca_connector.py::get_ohlcv requests /v2/stocks/{sym}/bars with the IEX feed and no session filter; bar t = bar START on the clock hour, so live 1h bars include pre/post-market trades and differ from the Yahoo regular-session :30 bars the one-read scored. Consequences to measure: (1) is_decision_bar fires at UTC close hours %4==0 incl. extended-hours bars (00/08/12 UTC) where a bracket cannot be placed; (2) ret_k / vol24 / ATR14 / range_pos counted over extended-hours bars. Method: pull 30 sessions of Alpaca IEX 1h bars and Yahoo RTH bars for the 13 alpaca_paper ETFs, compute the 20 features at each decision bar both ways, report the per-feature gap and the decision agreement (taken / side) of the frozen model. 2026-11-02 17:20Z (ALPACA-ML final, #22282 merged, deployed at 24fbc0e, observed at the 16:00Z decision): 13/13 ETFs evaluated, 3 SHORT (IAUM/QLD/USO; QLD placed on alpaca_paper), 3 below tau. BUG 1: 7/13 refused insufficient_bars. SPY 223, QQQ 221, IWM 215, TLT 243, SLV 267, TQQQ 238, GDX 203 vs MIN_BARS 337. The builder asks limit=400 1h, but the Alpaca client returns about 200-270; likely limit is mapped to a calendar lookback too short for IEX hours. Fix: widen or page the Alpaca 1h lookback (Tier 2, market-data path). BUG 2: IAUM and USO SHORTs were multi_account_dispatched with accounts_placed 0, refusal reason not read (suspects: same-symbol exclusivity vs iaum_pullback_1d, or shorting not allowed). Read the refusal from audit_query, then fix or record.
